scope: Additive evidence-only review of three exact frozen funded-2020 offerings; no canonical edits, rates, clock changes or promotion.

selected_offerings.question: Is sapientx.ai a verified continuation of the frozen issuer, and what dated platform evidence supports operations?
accepted_source_facts: Wefunder details states SapientX Inc. was incorporated in Delaware in April 2016 and reports annual revenue $34,100 for the period ended 2023-12-31.
Wefunder links the company to sapientx.com and names David Colleen.
Wefunder displays Last Funded January 2025, a month-only financing label.
held: No observed legal-identity bridge between sapientx.ai and frozen issuer. Do not carry its 2026-08-25 product-change date into issuer operation history.
2023 annual financial period does not prove current operation or continuous survival through 2026.
January 2025 financing label is not an exact event day or qualifying success.
Identity to the frozen issuer remains unreviewed against a strong-identifier OR two independent medium-identifier route with required second review; current profile supports candidate identity only.

selected_offerings.question: Is there explicit issuer-level winding-down evidence beyond the stale 2021 SEC fallback?
accepted_source_facts: A public notice naming Quadrant Biosciences Inc. as Delaware assignor states assignment for benefit of creditors on 2024-07-16, transfer of tangible/intangible asset rights for liquidation, and planned wind-down actions. Notice date is 2024-07-26.
The notice explicitly separates the Delaware assignor from a similarly named California assignee LLC.
Wefunder public post published 2021-02-17 says offering closes tomorrow February 18; this is planned closing, not actual completion.
held: The public PDF is a purported assignee-issued notice. Source-operator authority and identity to the frozen issuer remain unreviewed against a strong-identifier OR two independent medium-identifier route with required second review.
ABC date is not exact operating cessation or completed liquidation. July 1 shutdown from third-party employee/news material remains discovery only.
No platform-hosted explicit later closure was found in this bounded pass. Investor speculation is inadmissible.
No silent substitution for pinned 2021 censor or installed skill cessation inventory.

selected_offerings.question: Can later affirmative operations be established beyond 2021-03-23 and matched to the frozen issuer?
accepted_source_facts: Wefunder profile shows $120,601, matching frozen offering proceeds, Last Funded December 2020, and founder Ed Vincent.
A festivalPass-issued release dated 2022-06-01 announces a global marketplace launch and describes current member ticket/hotel access with founder Ed Vincent.
held: Press release is issuer-controlled off-platform evidence, not independent journalism. Brand/founder/product continuity supports candidate identity; identity to the frozen issuer remains unreviewed under strong-identifier OR two independent medium-identifier rules with required second review.
June 1, 2022 supports a dated issuer operating claim; it is not current 2026 operation or proof of continuous survival.
No later qualifying platform-hosted operation date recovered; StartEngine offering route returned JavaScript/robot verification. No CAPTCHA solved.
No native-baseline censor extension or cross-platform economic-round merger.
